other_conditions: All new and existing units must have their operations in Goa
The applicant unit must be one of: Proprietorship Firm, Private Limited Company, Public Limited Company, Registered Partnership Firm, or Limited Liability Partnership
Bank accounts of the unit and/or its partners/directors must be linked to Aadhaar
Eligibility requires production of Udyog Aadhaar
The unit must have operated from the office space for more than one year before claiming rebate
Employees must have been on the rolls of the company for a minimum period of one year
The unit must achieve investment and employment targets mentioned in the business plan
Only one of the two rebate options (land or built‑up space) can be availed
Direct employment must be proportional to built‑up space at up to 80 sq ft per employee
benefits_summary: One‑time rebate of up to ₹1.5 crore for land purchase or ₹1 crore for built‑up office space, calculated per employee (higher per‑female‑employee rate) and subject to employment and investment targets.
